modules.title: Every module your operations team asks for.
modules.lead: No bolted-together tools. Attendance, work and communication live in the same place, with data that stays in sync automatically.

attendance.title: Attendance & geofencing
attendance.body: Clock in and out with location awareness, shift tracking, overtime, and a manager approval queue for corrections.

tasks.title: Kanban task boards
tasks.body: Drag tasks through To Do, In Progress, Review and Revision, with per-person workload visible at a glance.

leave.title: Leave management
leave.body: Requests, balances and approvals in one thread. No more chasing signatures over chat.

calendar.title: Team calendar
calendar.body: Shifts, leave, holidays and deadlines on one calendar, in BS or AD — the view your team plans the week from.

messaging.title: Team messaging
messaging.body: Direct messages and channels, right next to the work they're about.

video.title: Video meetings
video.body: Standups and reviews with in-call chat, screen share and notes. No separate app to install.

dashboards.title: Role-based dashboards
dashboards.body: HR sees org-wide analytics and approvals. Staff see their own day. Same platform, right lens for each.

ai.title: AI-powered insights
ai.body: Anomaly flags on attendance, workload summaries and report generation. No data team required.

signIn.title: Sign in, clock in
signIn.body: One login per person. Attendance starts the moment they sign in — no separate biometric device to buy.

work.title: Work where the data lives
work.body: Tasks, leave and messages sit next to attendance, so status updates don't need a second tool.

pattern.title: See the pattern, not just the log
pattern.body: Dashboards turn raw check-ins and task history into the weekly view managers actually act on.

hr.label: HR & Admin
hr.title: Run the whole org from one screen
hr.body: Approve leave, review attendance exceptions and track team health without exporting a single CSV.

staff.label: Staff & Team Members
staff.title: A dashboard for your actual day
staff.body: Frontend, backend, QA or DevOps: the same shell adapts to each role's tasks and metrics.
points: My tasks, my leave, my session
